sections.head: Run visual checks inside functional tests

items.q: What is a visual testing tool?
items.a: A visual testing tool captures screenshots of your UI and compares them against approved baselines to catch layout, color and font bugs that functional tests miss.
Visual regression testing checks that a code change did not alter how a page or screen looks, by comparing new screenshots with earlier approved ones.

items.q: Can SmartUI compare against Figma designs?
items.a: Yes. SmartUI compares the built UI with Figma frames to catch design drift.

items.q: How does SmartUI reduce false positives?
items.a: SmartUI ignores anti-aliasing, dynamic content and regions you exclude, and its Visual AI mode judges which changes matter.

items.q: Which frameworks does SmartUI work with?
items.a: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer, Storybook and mobile frameworks, through SDKs and a CLI.
